svg.title: Microsoft Fabric Platform: Workloads Over One Shared Store
svg.desc: An architecture diagram showing how role-oriented workloads sit on OneLake, Purview, and Copilot, structured by the tenant, domain, workspace, and capacity hierarchy.
svg.text: Microsoft Fabric Platform — Unified Architecture & Tenancy
SaaS Foundation · Role-Oriented Workloads · OneLake Shared Store · Purview Governance · Capacity Budget

g.title: Fabric is SaaS, not PaaS — No Azure resource groups, ARM, redundancy settings, or region placement to manage — Microsoft manages the infrastructure.
g.text: Zero infrastructure provisioning, ARM templates, or VM management
• Covers ingestion, processing, warehousing, streaming, ML & BI in ONE product
• Eliminates stitching separate Azure services (ADF + Synapse + Databricks + PBI)
• No Azure Resource Groups, VNets, or redundancy zones to configure manually
Governance & security operate at Tenant, Domain & Workspace boundaries
rather than Azure-level network subscriptions or infrastructure firewalls.

g.title: Tenant, domains, workspaces — One tenant maps to one Entra tenant; domains group workspaces; workspaces hold items and draw from a capacity.
g.text: Delegated administrative boundaries across the enterprise
• Domain admins enforce business unit policy without modifying global tenant settings.
• Workspaces assign compute to Capacities for explicit chargeback & resource budgeting.

g.title: Role-oriented workloads — Power BI, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence, and more — each contributes its own item types.
OneLake (shared storage) — One logical data lake per tenant; every workload writes and reads the same Delta Parquet data.
g.text: OneLake — Single Logical Storage Layer (ADLS Gen2)
The "OneDrive for Data" providing single-copy architecture across all engines
Open Standard Delta Lake & Parquet by Default:
• All workloads ingest & persist in standard Delta Parquet — 0 vendor lock-in
• Automatic V-Order write optimization accelerates subsequent read queries
• Internal Shortcuts: Reference tables across workspaces without data copying
• External Shortcuts: Virtualize AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage & Azure ADLS
• Instant cross-engine access: Spark ➔ T-SQL ➔ Direct Lake on exact same file
Exactly ONE OneLake provisioned per Fabric tenant. Cannot be deleted or duplicated.
Unified global hierarchical namespace rooted at https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com

g.title: Purview governance — Built-in governance across data-estate management, protection, discovery, and monitoring — inherited automatically.
g.text: Centralized data estate security, discovery, compliance & lineage tracking
1. Tenant Defaults ➔ 2. Domain Overrides (Delegated) ➔ 3. Workspace Controls
Sensitivity labels propagate automatically down lineage chains across items.
Directly integrated into the Fabric admin experience — 0 external agent deployments
Tracks metadata, item relationships, and security classifications in real time.

g.title: Capacity (compute budget) — A dedicated pool of capacity units every workload draws from; sized by SKU.
g.text: Single shared compute currency powering every Fabric workload
• One unified pool of Capacity Units (CUs) powers Spark, T-SQL, KQL & VertiPaq
• Interactive vs Background: Interactive smoothed 5–64m; Background over 24h
• Bursting allows jobs to consume beyond provisioned rate for fast execution
Throttling is enforced per capacity, NOT tenant-wide. Assigning noisy ETL
to a dedicated capacity completely protects executive Power BI dashboards.

g.aria-label: Trap: tenant-wide private links are all-or-nothing
g.title: Trap: tenant-wide private links are all-or-nothing — Enabling tenant-level private links disables specific Power BI features and breaks on-premises gateways — a real trade-off, not free security.
g.text: • Enabling "Block Public Internet Access" breaks on-premises data gateway registration.
• Disables Publish to Web, email subscriptions, PDF/PPT export & Copilot features.
• Direct Lake fallback to SQL endpoint fails if private endpoint routing is misconfigured.
Evaluate private links as an architectural trade-off, not a free security toggle.
Migrate on-prem gateways to Managed VNet Data Gateways before enabling tenant block.

svg.text: Fabric Codex — Original Infographic, August 2026. Grounded in Microsoft Fabric Platform Architecture Specs.
